public_contract: The submitted Mutant Tanks core compiles, loads, and retains its upstream plugin identity.
The submitted primary abilities aggregate compiles and loads with Hypno registered.
The submitted secondary abilities aggregate compiles and loads with its upstream plugin identity.
Initial load and sm_mt_reload each deliver at least twenty observable MT_OnConfigsLoaded callbacks before the scoped argument checks run.
An ordinary General/Type Range callback preserves value 1-3, type -1, admin -1, mode 1, special false, and an empty special-section name on initial load and reload.

On initial load and reload, both Tank-type Health/Smoker Base Health=777 (type 1) and plugin-level Health/Smoker Base Health=606 (type -1) preserve admin -1, mode 1, special true, and exact special-section name Special.
The public MT_SpawnTank native creates the requested custom mutant Smoker through normal server lifecycle callbacks.
An explicit Tank-type Smoker base 777 plus extra 111 remains authoritative in both live and maximum engine health.
When the selected Tank type omits Health, plugin-level Smoker base 606 plus extra 6 wins in both live and maximum engine health.
An initialized guaranteed on-hit Warp relocates an eligible unpinned survivor through the normal SDKHooks damage callback.
After the same attacker proves Warp is available on its paired unpinned control, a survivor with a real Smoker-class tongue owner stays in place.
After the same attacker proves Warp is available on its paired unpinned control, a survivor with a real Hunter-class pounce attacker stays in place.
After the same attacker proves Warp is available on its paired unpinned control, a survivor with a real Jockey-class attacker stays in place.
After the same attacker proves Warp is available on its paired unpinned control, a survivor with a real Charger-class pummel attacker stays in place.
A live configured type-1 Boss crosses four engine-health thresholds and reaches public types 2, 3, 4, and 5 in order without disappearing or raising a SourceMod exception.
The live type-5 final Boss remains valid beyond multiple repeating timer ticks without an out-of-bounds failure.
Two real configured Tank deaths in A-then-B order credit the same survivor with combined Damage Boost and Ammo rewards through public apply=true callbacks.
After A then B, a real base-10 SMG hit deals exactly 15 damage because the later larger 2.0 multiplier does not add to or replace the active 1.5 value.
After A then B, the first regeneration tick adds exactly 10 rounds to both an empty real SMG magazine and empty reserve because the later larger value does not add or replace.
After bot_player_replace, the incoming survivor retains the A-then-B reward and a real base-10 SMG hit still deals exactly 15 damage.
After bot_player_replace, the replaced survivor no longer owns the reward and a real base-10 SMG hit deals exactly 10 damage.
After bot_player_replace, the incoming survivor's independently equipped empty real SMG receives exactly 10 magazine and reserve rounds on the first regeneration tick.
After bot_player_replace, the replaced survivor's independently equipped empty real SMG receives no regeneration from stale reward state.
Across the complete post-expiry observation window, the migrated combined A-then-B reward emits exactly one public apply=false callback for the incoming survivor.
After A-then-B reward expiry, a real base-10 SMG hit by the incoming survivor deals exactly 10 damage.
After A-then-B reward expiry, the incoming survivor's empty real SMG remains empty across a full regeneration interval.
Two real configured Tank deaths in B-then-A order credit the same survivor with combined Damage Boost and Ammo rewards through public apply=true callbacks.
After B then A, a real base-10 SMG hit deals exactly 35 damage because the later smaller 1.5 multiplier adds to the active 2.0 value.
After B then A, the first regeneration tick adds exactly 30 rounds to both an empty real SMG magazine and empty reserve.
After bot_player_replace, the incoming survivor retains the B-then-A reward and a real base-10 SMG hit still deals exactly 35 damage.
After the B-then-A handoff, the replaced survivor returns to exactly 10 damage.
After the B-then-A handoff, the incoming survivor's independently equipped empty real SMG receives exactly 30 magazine and reserve rounds on the first regeneration tick.
After the B-then-A handoff, the replaced survivor's independently equipped empty real SMG receives no regeneration.
Across the complete post-expiry observation window, the migrated combined B-then-A reward emits exactly one public apply=false callback for the incoming survivor.
After B-then-A reward expiry, a real base-10 SMG hit by the incoming survivor deals exactly 10 damage.
After B-then-A reward expiry, the incoming survivor's empty real SMG remains empty across a full regeneration interval.
Within a bounded post-spawn observation window, Hypno View=1 creates exactly one owner-parented shield even when gameplay activation is disabled; same-forward completion is not required.
Removing the owning Tank removes its shield and invalidates the old entref.
A later Tank lifecycle owns exactly one new shield and does not reuse the removed shield entref.
Hypno View=0 creates no shield at spawn or after ordinary ability activation.
An enabled guaranteed View=0 Hypno hit still applies its divided reflected-damage gameplay effect while producing no visual shield.
An enabled View=1 Tank has the same single owner-parented shield before and after ordinary ability activation.
Round reset and unloading the primary ability aggregate each remove all Hypno shields without an orphan or SourceMod exception.
Panic mode 2 with chance 100, amount 1, and explicit Panic Type=8 captures exactly one real infected entity total, and that entity is a Clown uncommon infected.
Under the same controlled activation, documented Panic Type=0 random fallback captures exactly one real infected entity total rather than none or multiple entities.
The sole captured Panic Type=0 fallback entity uses one of the seven documented uncommon-infected models.
A real class-8 Tank death credits the survivor through MT_OnRewardSurvivor(apply=true), and the survivor's active rainbow body reward changes render RGB before replacement.
After bot_player_replace, the replacement survivor continues the active rainbow render-color animation.
After bot_player_replace, the replaced bot remains at a stable neutral render color.
After player_bot_replace, the replacement idle bot continues the still-active rainbow render-color animation.
After player_bot_replace, the replaced player remains at a stable neutral render color.
Two real Tank-claw hits inside Acid Cooldown=2 create exactly one Tank-owned spitter projectile.
Two real Tank-claw hits inside Ammo Cooldown=2 drain a 100-round primary magazine and reserve exactly once to 90/90.
A later real Tank-claw hit after Acid Cooldown=2 expires creates the second Tank-owned spitter projectile.
A later real Tank-claw hit after Ammo Cooldown=2 expires drains the primary magazine and reserve a second time to 80/80.
Acid Cooldown=0 permits two cross-second real Tank-claw hits to create two Tank-owned spitter projectiles.
Ammo Cooldown=0 permits two cross-second real Tank-claw hits to drain the 100-round primary magazine and reserve twice to 80/80.
